identity.name: Casio MTP Standard
identity.one_liner: The 1995 Casio MTP — the $30 stainless-steel quartz that defined "an affordable dress watch you do not have to think about". The most-cited entry into the watch world.

narrative.story: The MTP-V002D was introduced in 1995 as the stainless-steel dress watch at the bottom of the Casio catalogue. The 1330 quartz module is the standard Casio three-hand quartz. The case is 38mm stainless steel with a mineral crystal. The result: a $30 watch that does not look like a $30 watch, with a 3-year battery and a 50m water resistance. The MTP is the most-cited entry into the watch world, and the watch a collector buys as their first watch before they know anything about watches.
narrative.collector_notes: The MTP-V002D-1B3 has a black dial with gold-tone hands and markers. The matching day-date version (MTP-VD01) is the most-cited budget watch in the world.
